acceptance: Engine jobs install constrained versions matching BenchBox's supported ranges; versions printed in job output.
Fork PR merged with green hosted checks.
description: Adversarial review M4: fork CI engine jobs install duckdb 2.0.0, datafusion 55, pyspark 4.2, chdb 4.4 (engines-requirements.txt unpinned; the duckdb<2 constraint only applies in package-test.yml:56, not benchbox-engines.yml:38,71) while BenchBox locks duckdb 1.5.5 (<2). Constrain the engine jobs to BenchBox's supported versions (read them from BenchBox's lock/pyproject) and print versions in job logs; document the version policy in downstream/README.md.
